clause: StudioGradient geometries + multi-stop ramp + on-canvas handles + swatch storage [STU-VEC-016,STU-VEC-051 gradient]

scope.summary: Implement StudioGradient fill geometries linear/radial (editable aspect)/angular-conic/diamond/freeform (free-placed points+lines, per-point spread+opacity), each with a multi-stop ramp (per-stop color+opacity), editable midpoint/skew, on-canvas handle editing of position/rotation/extent, per-gradient interpolation (perceptual|linear) + dithering toggle; applicable to fills and strokes (stroke mode within|along|across); storable as a typed swatch in StudioSwatch/StudioStyleRegistry (edit-updates-all-uses, break-link for local copy; freeform retains per-point editability). Mesh geometry is delivered by MT-129.
acceptance_criteria: 5 gradient geometries + multi-stop + on-canvas handles + swatch storage/break-link; author_ids + manual entry
expected_tests: argus: gradient tool + on-canvas handles reachable via author_id
test: linear/radial/angular/diamond/freeform ramps; stroke within/along/across; stored swatch edit updates all uses; break-link isolates copy

target_entries: Studio / Vector / Gradients (linear, radial, angular, diamond, freeform)

risk_if_missed: No gradients; core paint expressiveness missing.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
